How the evening works

What guests describe in the Google reviews and what the tavern shows in its own photos. Prices at the tavern.

The concept

  • No printed menu
  • A short explanation of each dish at the table
  • The dishes keep coming until you say stop
  • Drinks are charged on top

What arrives

  • Fresh bread
  • Dips, olives and salads
  • Vegetables, herbs and wild mushrooms
  • Hot dishes from the pan
  • A trio of desserts

At 7 St. Georges

Photos from the tavern’s own website.

No menu, just meze

7 St. Georges Tavern is a family style restaurant in Yeroskipou near Paphos, open Tuesday to Sunday from 19:00 to 22:00, with about 6,300 followers on Facebook. Guests write about the no menu concept, the meze that keeps coming, the trio of desserts at the end and the cats in the yard. On its own website the tavern writes about the ancient food of Cyprus and its philosophy of food.

What guests say

From the Google listing, 4.7 stars on average across 1,780 reviews.

“Absolutely love this place. We discovered it two decades ago and always make sure we visit when we’re in Paphos. The concept is brilliant: no menu, just authentic Cypriot meze served continuously until you ask them to stop. Always remember to save space for the trio of desserts, they are so delicious!”
Google review
“If you are looking for an authentic local culinary experience, don’t miss out on this place! Warm and friendly welcome, and they just kept bringing one amazing dish after another. The desserts were brilliant, and the atmosphere was great. It’s a 5-star experience for us.”
Google review
“Small plates until you drop. And believe me you will! Tasty homemade cooking delicious and a cosy village atmosphere will make your night. Have been here 20-25years ago and quality and quantity still the same. Concept, they will bring until you say stop.”
Google review
“We came across this little tavern in Paphos and honestly, what a lovely find! The food was really interesting, full of flavour, and absolutely delicious. Everything we tried was tasty, but the dessert was definitely the highlight absolutely amazing! The service was excellent, warm and welcoming, and the atmosphere was made even better by all the lovely cats wandering around.”
